source: S-002 owner-reported lost-interview failure; public-safe scenario summaries
limitations: Studied development cases, never held-out lift

cases.prompt: Interview me to make the RSI loop ready. We are exploring the requirements; keep interviewing until the important decisions are understood. The current implementation is the baseline. No implementation or document writes are requested in this transcript-only exercise.
cases.outcome: Advance a consequential unresolved decision through an interview question and wait; preserve the stated baseline and authority.

cases.prompt: Continue the active requirements interview. Already answered: approved r1, three candidate attempts excluding baseline, subscription usage meter. Assessment scope is still unanswered. I supplied the current implementation branch as evidence; the branch has no scored assessment report. This is a transcript-only exercise with no document tools.
cases.outcome: Preserve the answers and implementation baseline, use the branch as context and continue the unresolved interview; do not invent a missing-report prerequisite.

cases.prompt: The interview was displaced by investigation. What happened to my grilling session? That was a failure. Resume from these settled choices: r1, three attempts excluding baseline, subscription meter, candidate assessments separate from whole-system fitness. The outstanding decision is which real failure should be the first improvement case. No repair, implementation or document write is authorized by this transcript-only exercise.
cases.outcome: Apply the correction and ask the next consequential unresolved question without reopening settled choices or starting an unsolicited repair.
